checked_scope: The CARA compensation formula, bounded-loss identified interval, and threshold-CDF bounds.
checks: CARA sharing utility factors as a strictly positive finite exponential times the negative exponential loss moment. An infinite moment prevents any finite compensation; with finite moment logarithms give a−b+log(M)/γ, separately restricted to v>−c.

Jensen and the exponential endpoint chord give sharp moment endpoints under bounded losses and known mean. A point mass and endpoint Bernoulli attain them; mixtures preserve the mean and fill every compensation value, including degenerate mean endpoints.
For θf=v*−δf, any value in all frame intervals constructs valid bounded wedges. Events θ≤v−κ and v*≤v imply the two CDF envelope inequalities, and constant extreme wedges attain the envelopes.
